title: Impacts of pore size in binding dynamics of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) on modified graphene materials
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00030K, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Timothy C. Schutt, Caitlin G. Bresnahan, Timothy C. Ricard, Manoj K. Shukla
We have identified critical pore diameters that impact the thermodynamics and kinetics of PFAS binding and transport, and elucidate design parameters with which to tune PFAS adsorption media to different partitioning, transport, and selectivity.
